name: coolify
description_en: An open-source, self-hostable PaaS alternative to Vercel, Heroku & Netlify that lets you easily deploy static sites, databases, full-stack applications and 280+ one-click services on your own servers.
readme_excerpt: Coolify An open-source & self-hostable Heroku / Netlify / Vercel alternative. About the Project Coolify is an open-source & self-hostable alternative to Heroku / Netlify / Vercel / etc. It helps you manage your servers, applications, and databases on your own hardware; you only need an SSH connection. You can manage VPS, Bare Metal, Raspberry PIs, and anything else. Imagine having the ease of a cloud but with your own servers. That is Coolify. No vendor lock-in, which means that all the configu…
